location_exception_reason: Bunk House Office is a standardised industrial product category with pan-India supply and delivery. Location of manufacture or seller is not a buyer decision factor; the product specification (dimensions, insulation, materials) is. No GI protection or regional origin requirement applies.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) in titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Bunk House Office Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The product itself does not change based on who sells it.
